name: the one reader of C6 and its canonical printer (step 1 of COMPASS-REBOL-06), fixtures first
comment: Written BEFORE block_lib.haro and block.haro. Carried verbatim from study/rebol/printing_fixtures.json: the sixteen C6 fixtures (L01-L04, L07; D01-D03, D05; K01, K02; F01-F04, F06). Added for Haro: H01-H04 and D06-D08 (Haro's `?` is C6 by Q-B1, paths, numbers, comments), K04-K07 (the printer on those), F07-F12 (Q-B2's two amendments refused by name until Ringua's text lands; a path with spaces; a `?` on nothing; mixed case; a pair with no value). "same" pairs must read to equal blocks, "differ" pairs must not; "canonical" gives the one printing; "refused" a text the reader refuses, with a fragment of why. Every fixture is judged on haro and on its checked build, byte-identical. left_to_step_3 names the five memo-spelling fixtures the guard skips, so a scoped run prints what it skipped.

same.name: one declaration, one line and many lines
same.a: DEFINE MENU tones AS (WORDS [plain, formal], CODE "X") RATIONALE "the tones"
same.b:
DEFINE MENU tones AS (
  WORDS [
    plain,
    formal,
  ],
  CODE "X",
) RATIONALE "the tones"

same.name: a string across lines folds its continuation indent to one space (C6 3.2)
same.a:
DEFINE X y AS () RATIONALE "a long
    rationale"
same.b: DEFINE X y AS () RATIONALE "a long rationale"

same.name: CRLF and LF are the same text (C6 3.10)
same.a:
DEFINE MENU tones AS (
WORDS [plain, formal], CODE "X") RATIONALE "the tones"
same.b:
DEFINE MENU tones AS (
WORDS [plain, formal], CODE "X") RATIONALE "the tones"

same.name: a comment survives as a value of the block, in its place
Haro's `?` is C6 (Q-B1): an optional seat, on one line and on many
same.a: DEFINE DECLARATION deposit AS (SEATS [amount: number, note: text?, tags: [tag]?]) RATIONALE "a deposit"
same.b:
DEFINE DECLARATION deposit AS (
  SEATS [
    amount: number,
    note: text?,
    tags: [tag]?,
  ],
) RATIONALE "a deposit"

same.name: a path is one value, however the layout around it
a negative and a decimal number, spaced or not
a comment at the end of a line and on its own line are one block: a comment is a value, layout is not
same.a: DEFINE X y AS () RATIONALE "r" -- why
same.b:
DEFINE X y AS () RATIONALE "r"
-- why

differ.name: two items are not one row of two values
a string is not a word
a keyword is not a word: case is meaning (C6 3.4, 3.5)

a comment is a value of the block: a text with it is not the text without it (added after the reader: L07 compared two texts that both held the comment, so it could not see a reader that drops comments)
a path is not two words
an optional value is not the value (Q-B1)
a group is not a list

canonical.name: a declaration: its clauses one a line, a list inline, no trailing comma
canonical.text:
DEFINE MENU tones AS (
  WORDS [
    plain,
    formal,
  ],
  CODE "X",
) RATIONALE "the tones"
canonical.canonical:
DEFINE MENU tones AS (
  WORDS [plain, formal],
  CODE "X"
) RATIONALE "the tones"

canonical.name: two declarations: a blank line between them
canonical.text: DEFINE MENU tones AS (WORDS [plain, formal], CODE "X") RATIONALE "the tones" DEFINE MENU moods AS (WORDS [plain, formal], CODE "X") RATIONALE "the moods"
canonical.canonical:
DEFINE MENU tones AS (
  WORDS [plain, formal],
  CODE "X"
) RATIONALE "the tones"

DEFINE MENU moods AS (
  WORDS [plain, formal],
  CODE "X"
) RATIONALE "the moods"

canonical.name: an optional seat keeps its `?`, a path its dots; a list of pairs prints inline
canonical.text: DEFINE DECLARATION deposit AS (SEATS [amount: number, note: text?], POINTS [deposit.amount: trusted]) RATIONALE "a deposit"
canonical.canonical:
DEFINE DECLARATION deposit AS (
  SEATS [amount: number, note: text?],
  POINTS [deposit.amount: trusted]
) RATIONALE "a deposit"

canonical.name: a comment stands on its own line; a list holding a comment, and a list holding a group, print one item a line
canonical.canonical:
(
  A 1,
  -- why
  B [
    x,
    -- here
    y
  ],
  C (
    D 2
  )
)

canonical.name: a comment ends its line; two declarations keep a blank line between them
canonical.text:
DEFINE MENU tones AS (WORDS [plain, formal], CODE "X") RATIONALE "the tones" -- after
-- alone
DEFINE MENU moods AS (WORDS [calm]) RATIONALE "the moods"
canonical.canonical:
DEFINE MENU tones AS (
  WORDS [plain, formal],
  CODE "X"
) RATIONALE "the tones"

-- after

-- alone

DEFINE MENU moods AS (
  WORDS [calm]
) RATIONALE "the moods"

refused.name: single quotes are .zql's divergence (D-ZQL-1), not C6
a comma outside a list or a group
an empty item between two commas (added after the reader: no fixture pinned the refusal, found by switching it off)
a string as a pair's key waits for C6's amendment (Q-B2, Ringua writes it): refused by name until its text lands
refused.why: pair's key waits for C6's amendment (Q-B2)

refused.name: a doubled quote inside a string waits for C6's amendment (Q-B2): a C6 string has no escape today
refused.why: doubled quote inside a string waits for C6's amendment (Q-B2)

refused.name: a path is written without spaces
a `?` marks the value before it; here nothing stands before it
mixed case is neither a word nor a keyword (C6 3.4, 3.5; the study reader read it as a word -- Haro refuses it, as both its lexers did)
refused.why: neither a lower_snake identifier nor an UPPER_SNAKE keyword
